subject: Signed artifact handshake, dry-run simulation & network blueprint
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <ops@stellarnet.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <sre-lead@stellarnet.com>
Date: Sun, 5 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Air-gapped update: validation requirements and dry-run?

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the earlier call. We’re prepping an air-gapped rollout for StellarNet’s analytics cluster and need to confirm Redwood’s signed artifact handshake and verification steps. Our security team wants a short dry-run before the scheduled maintenance window.

High-level asks:
- Exact signature verification commands (we run only on an isolated jump host)
- Key rotation/attestation expectations for the bundle signer
- Network topology requirements for the one-way transfer (we’ll be using removable media + an intermediate staging host)
- A short checklist we can run during the dry-run (target: 30–45m)

Can you confirm availability next week for a 30m dry-run and share a draft checklist we can walk through?

Appreciate it,
Alex Rivera
Ops Lead, StellarNet
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <ops@stellarnet.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Air-gapped update: validation requirements and dry-run?

Hi Alex —

Thanks — I sketched a minimal handshake and dry-run plan and attached the bundle manifest + signature stub. Short answers up front:

1) Verification steps (jump host):
   - Ensure offline host has the RedKey (public) installed: openssl x509 -in redwood_pub.pem -noout -text
   - Verify signature: sha256sum signed-bundle-v1.2.tar | openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_pub.pem -signature signed-bundle-v1.2.tar.sig
   - Compare manifest checksum: sha256sum bundle-manifest-v1.2.yml

2) Key rotation / attestation:
   - We sign each release with a short-lived signing key that has hardware-backed protection (HSM). Rotation cadence: quarterly; emergency rotation: immediate on compromise.
   - We’ll provide a signed attestation blob for the signing key used in this release and a key id you can check against our public key registry.

3) Network / transfer expectations:
   - Media transfer requires a staging host with two NICs: the isolated ingest NIC (no upstream route), and the admin NIC (restricted to the jump host).
   - The ingest interface must have no default route and iptables configured to DROP outbound by default.
   - If you plan to use a USB-attached drive, ensure the drive is mounted read-only on the ingest host during verification.

4) Dry-run checklist: attached (airgap-dryrun-checklist.xlsx). I’ve also exported a VPC diagram that shows the recommended staging host topology (network-blueprint-vpc-diagram.png).

We can run a 30m dry-run on Thu 9/9 or Mon 9/13. Which works for you?

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Field Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Priya Shah <sre-lead@stellarnet.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Alex Rivera <ops@stellarnet.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Air-gapped update: validation requirements and dry-run?

Markus — quick clarifying question from our SREs: the verification command you provided uses openssl to verify the detached signature. Will Redwood also provide a detached JSON attestation that lists the signing key id and build provenance (git commit, build timestamp)? We prefer an auditable artifact we can archive alongside the bundle.

Also — for the staging host, do you recommend an additional HSM verification step (YubiKey attached to admin NIC) or is the MD5/sha256 + signature sufficient for our compliance auditors?

Thanks,
Priya
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <sre-lead@stellarnet.com>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Air-gapped update: validation requirements and dry-run?

Priya —

We will provide a signed JSON attestation file (bundle-attestation-v1.2.json.sig + bundle-attestation-v1.2.json). The attestation contains: signing_key_id, build_commit, builder_image_hash, build_timestamp, and an HSM attestation statement.

For auditors: the detached signature + JSON attestation is preferred. If StellarNet wants an extra manual HSM confirmation step (e.g., a YubiKey presence check on-bump), we can add a short procedure to the checklist; it’s not required for cryptographic verification but helps with on-site evidence collection.

I’ll attach the attestation template to the runbook in the drive link and copy the checklist owners — Marissa, can you add the extra step for optional on-site HSM confirmation?

Evelyn Hart
Head, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <ops@stellarnet.com>, Priya Shah <sre-lead@stellarnet.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Sep 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Air-gapped update: validation requirements and dry-run?

Alex / Priya —

Confirmed: we’ll run the dry-run on Thu 9/16 at 09:00 PT (30m window). Agenda:
- 09:00 — 09:05: introduce participants and scope (jump host only)
- 09:05 — 09:20: verify signature + manifest checksum + attestation review
- 09:20 — 09:30: simulate install verification (no write-to-production) + debrief

I uploaded the following stubs to the Drive link: signed-bundle-v1.2.tar.sig, bundle-manifest-v1.2.yml, airgap-dryrun-checklist.xlsx, network-blueprint-vpc-diagram.png. Please confirm you received the attachments and that the window works.

Notes: bring a local admin user with sudo access on the staging host and ensure the staging host’s ingest interface has the route table entries removed before the start.

Cheers,
Markus
